text:
maria-cs: Escalation from Acme — they get 403 on /v1/generate but embeddings endpoint works. Customer says this started after nightly rotation. They pasted the curl and response below.

sam-eng: Can you drop the repro curl + the exact response body? Also which token type (svc acct vs user)?

maria-cs: svcacct token (rotates). curl:
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"write a short haiku"}'
```
Response:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Forbidden: request requires scope 'inference'",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "code": 403
  }
}
```

kevin-sre: thanks. That looks like a classic scope mismatch. Any chance the provisioning job modified scopes during rotation?

provisioner-bot: Automatic rotation job completed for svcacct id svc-ACME-42 at 2023-07-02T03:00:11Z. Applied scopes: [embeddings, rerank]. Requested scopes: [embeddings, rerank, inference].

sam-eng: interesting — bot shows requested scopes included inference but applied scopes omitted it. I pulled the token row from the auth DB: `select scopes from tokens where id='svc-ACME-42'` -> "embeddings,rerank" (no inference).

sam-eng: quick repro locally: create svcacct with embeddings+inference, run rotation job v1.3.7 — rotation hits a path that filters scopes using org_policy flag `disable_generation` and silently drops inference. Patchable.

maria-cs: Customer wants timeline and mitigation now. Can we reapply inference without forcing a key rotation on their side?

sam-eng: We can hotfix two ways: 1) admin re-grant scope on token row (db update), then restart token cache (fast but manual + audit). 2) deploy fix to provisioner so future rotations preserve inference when explicitly requested. Immediate recommendation: perform manual regrant + rotate token to force new claim if they want zero downtime. If they prefer no rotation, we can apply the DB patch and flush cache — they'll be able to call generate immediately.

kevin-sre: I'll run the manual regrant and flush the cache after hours (low traffic window) and coordinate with customer. Also adding an alert for provisioner job discrepancies.

maria-cs: please include minimal repro steps for customer to validate once we patch.

sam-eng: repro steps for customer to validate after we regrant: 1) use existing svc token and call /v1/generate with the same curl above — expect 200 + generated text. 2) call /v1/embeddings — should remain working. 3) check response header `x-token-scopes` which we added to help debug (should list `inference,embeddings,rerank`). Example success snippet:
```json
{
  "id": "resp-123",
  "generated_text": "\nAn old pond...\n"
}
```

maria-cs: customer replied they prefer not to rotate keys tonight, asked for ETA.

kevin-sre: ETA for manual regrant + cache flush: ~45 minutes. I'll post when done and include the x-token-scopes check.

provisioner-bot: Created ticket PROV-912: provisioner filters scopes when org policy `disable_generation` is set. Assigned to sam-eng.

sam-eng: root cause: rotation code invoked org policy check and used an older policy mapping that treats `inference` as disallowed (a previous policy change used the label `generation` and the mapping missed it). We'll release a one-line fix to the mapping and a regression test.

maria-cs: thanks — please keep me posted so I can update Acme. :thumbsup:

kevin-sre: manual regrant applied, cache flushed, asked customer to retry. Customer confirms success: 200 on generate and `x-token-scopes: inference,embeddings,rerank`. Closing loop.

maria-cs: great, closing on our side. Action items: sam-eng will ship provisioner fix + add unit test; kevin-sre to add rotation discrepancy alert; we document mitigation steps in runbook.

sam-eng: I'll open PR and link PROV-912 in the changelog.

kevin-sre: :white_check_mark:
